method: Compiled and minified Node ESM bundle of actual shared simulation; fixed production brokenSea terrain and prepared navigation masks; 20 transport ships on distinct eastbound voyages; 2.5s warmup, then 10s pre-change; tick set to 9599 for next step; 10s post-change. Three timing trials run sequentially without geometry audit. Separate identical trajectory audited every tick.
limits: Controlled navigation scenario without AI planning, combat, passengers or renderer. This is not a crowded fleet/large battle guarantee; timings measured on this workspace machine. Preliminary unbundled tsx audit run had one unrelated-to-route-change 90.52ms late outlier; all compiled measurements remained below 50ms.
